An O3 frontend module declares its configuration schema by calling `defineConfigSchema(moduleName, schema)` from its entry-point `index.ts`, usually inside `startupApp()`. I didn't open the linked docs page or any chart config-schema file, only the framework function and its call sites. The patient-chart results come from a search capped at 15 hits, so that list is not complete.

**Implementation**
- `defineConfigSchema` is in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts:369`.
  - It validates the schema.
  - It merges in the implicit schema.
  - It stores the result in `configInternalStore.schemas[moduleName]`. Implementers can then override values for that module through config.
  - Its doc comment (lines 357-368) points to the Configuration System docs at https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/configuration-system.
- It is exported publicly from `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/public.ts:4`, together with `defineExtensionConfigSchema`, `provide` and `getConfig`.
- Core modules call it the same way:
  - `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/index.ts:20`
  - `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/index.ts:28`
  - `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/setup.ts:9`
